title: Synthetic low lubrication-pressure alarm checks
provenance_detail: Original synthetic maintenance guidance authored for local deterministic retrieval; it contains no proprietary procedures or calibrated machine limits.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: For a synthetic low lubrication-pressure alarm, check the displayed gauge or sensor, reservoir indication, filter indication, visible leaks, and pump status. Repeat the pressure observation before separating a delivery condition from an indication problem.
observable_symptoms: machine unavailable after a low lubrication-pressure alarm
chunks.possible_explanation: A reservoir, restriction, leakage, pump-indication, or pressure-measurement condition is possible.
suggested_checks: Have an authorized operator inspect the displayed reservoir, filter, leak, and pump indications.
Repeat or cross-check the lubrication-pressure observation.
Compare the pressure indication with temperature and vibration observations from the same time window.
limitations: The fixture defines no calibrated pressure threshold or hydraulic model.
These checks do not establish a cause, prove damage, or confirm that maintenance is complete.
